source: POST /mockserver/wasm/test builds new WasmRuntime(bytes), whose wasmMaxMemoryPages and wasmExecutionTimeoutMillis come from the static ConfigurationProperties (the startup values), while the WASM body matcher reads the live Configuration a PUT /mockserver/configuration changes

steps.note: startup values: 4 pages, growing by 10 fails
the dry run keeps the startup page cap
the dry run keeps the startup budget: a looping module fails closed after 1500 ms, not 60 s
the body matcher reads the live configuration
8.0.0's body matcher reads HttpState's copy of the configuration, which a PUT of /mockserver/configuration does not reach; with one configuration (adopted upstream fix) it grows
lower the page cap at runtime: the dry run keeps the startup cap of 4, the body matcher follows
